preconditions.expression: len(s1) >= 1 and len(s1) <= 100 and len(s2) >= 1 and len(s2) <= 100 and len(virus) >= 1 and len(virus) <= 100
preconditions.description: The lengths of s1, s2, and virus are between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isupper() and c.isalpha() for c in s1) and all(c.isupper() and c.isalpha() for c in s2) and all(c.isupper() and c.isalpha() for c in virus)
preconditions.description: All three input strings consist only of uppercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output string is a longest common subsequence of s1 and s2 that does not contain virus as a substring, or '0' if no such non-empty subsequence exists.
